why_ai: A licensed architect must seal the documents and carries personal liability, and owners hire a named design leader for novel buildings.
why_clarity: Drawings are checkable against code, but every building is a one-off and design quality shows only in construction and occupancy.
why_digital: Design and documentation happen in Revit on screen, but construction administration needs site visits and clients hire state-licensed firms they know.

why_ai: Sealed documents, qualifications-based selection on relationships and agency review keep licensed architects central to public and hospital buildings.
why_clarity: Owner standards and agency rules are explicit, but programmes vary and outcomes surface years after occupancy.
why_digital: Design is digital, but selection interviews, stakeholder meetings and site work keep buying local.

why_ai: Clinical planning judgement and sealed drawings reviewed by state health agencies protect the work, and demand grows with ageing populations.
why_clarity: FGI and state rules codify room requirements, though clinical flow is judged by users after opening.
why_digital: Room data and models are digital; user groups, agency meetings and site visits are in person.

why_ai: Sealed documents, community engagement and district relationships protect the work, though school types repeat.
why_clarity: Bond budgets and agency review give checkable targets, but whether a programme delivered is known at bid and completion.
why_digital: Facility assessments, board meetings and community sessions are local and in person; design itself is digital.

why_ai: The seal still applies, but yield studies and unit layouts are exactly what generative feasibility tools now do.
why_clarity: Units, rentable area and cost per unit are measurable, and layouts repeat across projects.
why_digital: Feasibility and design run on screen for developers who often work across regions.

why_ai: Site observation and payment certification need the architect of record in person, carrying liability for every response.
why_clarity: Submittals and RFIs are compared against written specifications on contractual clocks.
why_digital: Reviews happen on screen inside construction platforms, but site visits tie the work to the project's location.

why_ai: Existing fabric must be surveyed on site and preservation judgement defended before state and federal reviewers.
why_clarity: The Secretary's Standards are interpretive and every historic building is different, with approval known months later.
why_digital: Starts from a physical building and archives, ends in drawings and applications, procured through local developers.

why_ai: The owner-architect seals every job personally and wins on local relationships and responsiveness.
why_clarity: Small residential and tenant-improvement work repeats, and permit review gives moderately quick feedback.
why_digital: Drawings are produced on screen, but clients, sites and building departments are local.

why_ai: Exam preparation and experience tracking are content and record-keeping that AI tutors and software absorb; mentoring is the protected part.
why_clarity: Exam objectives and experience requirements are codified, and exam results are pass or fail.
why_digital: Records, prep courses and exam scheduling are online; only the exam itself is proctored in person.

why_ai: Code calculations are rule-based and automatable, though the analysis sits on sealed sheets.
why_clarity: Occupancy, egress and area calculations follow the code exactly, and examiners return pass or fail within weeks.
why_digital: Model data in, code sheets and responses out through permit portals, within one jurisdiction's rules.

why_ai: Sheet setup, schedules and cross-referencing are mechanical production that automation and offshore drafting already take.
why_clarity: Internal consistency of a sheet set is objectively checkable and the same tasks recur on every project.
why_digital: Entirely model and sheet work on screen, routinely outsourced to drafting bureaus abroad.

why_ai: Licensed engineers negotiate alternatives with fire marshals and building officials, who accept arguments from people they trust.
why_clarity: Code reports have a defined form, but alternative approaches are argued case by case with feedback at permit review.
why_digital: Drawings in, reports out on screen, with AHJ meetings and some site work; large firms serve clients nationally.

why_ai: Estimating is quantitative screen work AI assists, though owners pay for an independent, accountable cost opinion.
why_clarity: Estimates are numbers built by standard methods, but accuracy is known only at bid or completion.
why_digital: Drawings and cost data in, cost plans out, sold through owner relationships.

why_ai: Credit review against a published rating system is routine document checking, protected mainly by the brand and the market's acceptance.
why_clarity: Credits have explicit requirements, reviews repeat by the thousand and outcomes are pass or fail.
why_digital: Documentation is uploaded and reviewed online for projects worldwide.

why_ai: Plans examiners act under delegated code authority and licence, though the checking itself is increasingly automatable.
why_clarity: Review is against adopted code with an approve-or-correct outcome on every submission.
why_digital: Drawings in and comments out through permit portals, under contracts with jurisdictions.

why_ai: Site surveys of existing facilities are physical, and certifications carry accountability in settlement and litigation contexts.
why_clarity: ADA and Fair Housing requirements are dimensional and checkable, and reviews repeat.
why_digital: Plan review is digital; facility surveys require on-site measurement.

why_ai: Dataset curation and LCA calculation are data work AI pipelines accelerate; regulatory acceptance of the dataset is the protection.
why_clarity: LCA methods are standardised, but whether results reflect built reality is rarely checked.
why_digital: EPDs and models in, datasets and reports out, sold globally online.

why_ai: Water and air testing of mock-ups and installed assemblies is hands-on field work with professional accountability.
why_clarity: Field tests give objective pass or fail, though design peer review is judgement.
why_digital: Starts from drawings and physical assemblies on site, delivered as reports to local projects.

why_ai: Specification text drafting is language work AI does well; the publisher's authority and the AIA brand are the protection.
why_clarity: Sections follow a fixed format and update against referenced standards.
why_digital: Content written and delivered entirely through software subscriptions.

why_ai: Document and budget review is screen work that AI assists, with lenders paying for an independent opinion.
why_clarity: Reviews follow a checklist, but whether the findings mattered is known only as the project is built.
why_digital: Documents in, reports out to lenders who buy nationally.

why_ai: Legally defensible licensure exams stay with the national body even as item writing automates.
why_clarity: Psychometric methods are codified and item statistics are objective.
why_digital: Exams developed on screen but delivered at proctored test centres.

why_ai: Occupant research needs site observation and client access, though analysis and writing automate.
why_clarity: Research topics vary and their effect on design quality is rarely measured.
why_digital: Surveys and observation in client buildings, reports published online.

why_ai: Survey analysis is screen work AI accelerates; the association's brand and panel give the protection.
why_clarity: Monthly and biennial releases repeat, but forecast quality is judged slowly.
why_digital: Panel survey data in, indices and reports out online.

why_ai: Statutory authority to license and discipline must be exercised by the board.
why_clarity: Licensure criteria are codified; complaint adjudication is less routine.
why_digital: Applications are digital, but jurisdiction is state-bound with in-person hearings.

why_ai: AI rendering tools substitute directly for standard architectural imagery.
why_clarity: Briefs are clear and revisions quick, though quality is partly taste.
why_digital: Models in, images out, routinely bought from studios abroad.

why_ai: Founders sell firms through advisors they trust, and each transaction is a negotiated, high-stakes judgement.
why_clarity: Valuation methods exist but every deal is bespoke and outcomes take years.
why_digital: Financials in and advice out, but negotiations and relationships run in person.
